records.rationale: The packet contains the ClaimsPro and Snowflake intake record, the adjuster notes (adjuster_notes.md), the 4-page shop estimate GC-24418 (repair_estimate.pdf) and 2 damage photos (IMG_0071.jpg, IMG_0072.jpg); the checklist is complete and the estimate total of 2,825.07 matches the intake amount. The date of loss is blank in every source and the policy period is not in the record, so neither coverage at the time of loss nor timely filing can yet be checked. The intake record gives the loss state and plate as Texas, while repair_estimate.pdf places the insured, the plate, the shop and the pricing in Tampa, Florida. adjuster_notes.md describes a backing incident, while repair_estimate.pdf describes pulling forward into a bollard. The intake record shows 'Paid in Full' while status_history.md shows the claim only received and assigned. The claim needs information requested from the insured: the date of loss, confirmation of where the loss happened and which state applies, the policy period, and a consistent account of the incident, before a person can decide it. No denial indicator is supported by positive evidence on file.
